meta.description: Builds and applies 3D pharmacophore models using RDKit Pharm3D, receptor interaction analysis, and pharmacophore search workflows.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All execution claims are backed by captured RDKit 2026.03.6 and PLIP 3.0.1 runs on real PDB structures or valid real-drug SMILES; no invented results, statistics, or citations were used.

practice_boundaries.detail: The seven outputs perform molecular-modeling workflows and contain no individual diagnosis, treatment prescription, or medical conclusion.

methodological_ground.detail: The skill distinguishes application of a supplied pharmacophore from consensus derivation, warns that its coordinates are placeholders, treats the relaxed feature prefilter as coarse, and requires a distance-constrained follow-up.

code_usability.detail: Every runnable SKILL.md block and examples/pharmacophore.py route was executed from saved scripts; all assertions passed and all required imports resolved in the declared environments.

functional_suitability.note: Covers ligand-based application, interaction-derived receptor analysis, pharmacophore search boundaries, validation, and explicit adjacent-skill handoffs.

reliability.note: Documented PLIP workaround, failure modes, fixed seeds, and the strict/relaxed feature-family diagnostic cover the observed routes; a bounds-infeasible EmbedPharmacophore error still relies on user inspection rather than a reusable handler.

performance_context.note: The 299-line SKILL.md is direct and the short usage guide points to the authoritative sections, though several external routes require separate tool documentation.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, feature taxonomy, worked code, validation criteria, and concrete failure modes make cold-start execution clear; search-engine conversion remains intentionally tool-specific.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger cases and concise prerequisites are present; exact hosted-service query setup must be checked against the deployed interface.

security.note: No secrets, raw shell execution, or destructive operations are present. Molecule and structure files are accepted as scientific inputs without an explicit untrusted-file policy.

maintainability.note: The example is self-contained and its changed return contract has one verified caller; apo2ph4, Pharmit, and PharmacoForge stay documentation-directed external seams.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise, fixed-seed examples are repeatable, and stop/hand-off conditions are documented; the broad description necessarily spans tools not bundled in the skill.
